rows.name: BUSES
rows.from: QLogic ISP12160A data sheet (1999), first page: dual-channel Ultra3 SCSI; IRIX 6.5 Octane SCSI driver object sends per-bus commands for a part with more than one bus

rows.name: CONTROLLER_PROGRAM_WORDS
rows.from: IRIX 6.5 Bedrock-class controller object: the separate ISP12160 controller program it carries is 27,706 bytes, and the program's image header word at index 3 is this value

rows.name: DRIVER_SELECTION_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT
rows.from: IRIX 6.5 Octane SCSI driver object: per-bus record defaults for device 0x1216

rows.name: OP_ABORT_DEVICE
rows.from: IRIX 6.5 Bedrock-class controller object, which constructs this request and calls the recovery helper that issues it; the Linux qla1280 driver header names the same opcode

rows.name: OP_BUS_RESET
rows.from: IRIX 6.5 Bedrock-class controller object (the request it builds); mailbox placement matches Linux qla1280's bus reset (driver header and bus-reset routine) (see the ISP1040 unit's OP_BUS_RESET)

rows.name: OP_DUMP_RAM
rows.from: stock PROM 6.210 SCSI diagnostic, which prepares this opcode against the ISP12160 when it tests DMA

rows.name: OP_LOAD_RAM
rows.from: stock PROM 6.210 SCSI diagnostic, which prepares this opcode against the ISP12160 when it tests DMA

rows.name: OP_SET_SELECTION_TIMEOUT
rows.from: Linux qla1280 (its driver header and controller set-up code, a driver for the QLA12160 as well), and the NetBSD isp and OpenBSD qlw drivers; IRIX 6.5 Octane SCSI driver object for device 0x1216

rows.name: PCI_BUS_WIDTH_BITS
rows.from: QLogic ISP12160A data sheet (1999), first page: "64-bit bus master"

rows.name: PCI_CLOCK_MHZ
rows.from: QLogic ISP12160A data sheet (1999), first page: "66-MHz, 64-bit PCI host bus interface" (the /66 version; a /33 version also exists)
